Section.Title: Dedicated Healing
Section.Hint: Once treated, this condition absorbs healing instead of hit points, and clears when it has taken enough.

Field.RequiredHint: HP of dedicated healing needed to clear this. 0 = off for this buff.
Field.DCHint: Heal check to make it ready to absorb healing. 0 waives the check.
